# Aranza Isea — Senior Product Designer · Product, UX/UI & AI

> Senior Product Designer with 10+ years in product design, UX/UI design and user research. Takes products from research to developer handoff across B2B e-commerce, loyalty and mobile apps, design systems and enterprise SaaS, and in recent years specialized in AI products: generative AI copilots, AI agents and human-in-the-loop workflows for insurance and fintech. Based in Buenos Aires, Argentina; works remotely (GMT-3). Spanish native, English C1. Available to start immediately.

Contact: aranzaisea@gmail.com · https://www.linkedin.com/in/aranzaiseaux

## Experience
- Independent product work, Sep 2026 – present: designed Numi (independent iOS product), earned AI certifications from IBM and Coderhouse and rebuilt the portfolio.
- Senior Product Designer, AI Products — Perficient, Jan 2024 – Aug 2026: owned ClaimPro end to end (generative AI claims copilot, ~500 insurance adjusters, −68% claim resolution time client-reported over 3 months, 90%+ adoption); designed Vantage (multi-agent AI for AML compliance at a neobank).
- Senior UX/UI Designer — Perficient, 2022 – 2024: Off Dep Business (AI-assisted B2B purchasing, research with 20 Business buyers; +65% Business accounts, +56% B2B sales, +47% retention), Club Rumbo (loyalty app MVP, iOS and Android, one month).
- Senior Visual Designer — Perficient, 2019 – 2022: built and scaled Perficient's Advanced Design System.
- Product Designer — Distrito Moda, 2017 – 2019. Junior UX/UI Designer — Tsserapp, 2015 – 2017.
